extDescription.message: Ground News style bias check for any article, powered by TypeSafe.

levelFarLeftBlurb.message: Consistently framed from a progressive viewpoint.

levelLeftBlurb.message: Word choice and sourcing tilt toward progressive views.

levelCenterBlurb.message: Balanced framing with neutral word choice.

levelRightBlurb.message: Word choice and sourcing tilt toward conservative views.

levelFarRightBlurb.message: Consistently framed from a conservative viewpoint.

langNeutralBlurb.message: Plain, descriptive wording with attributed claims.

langSomewhatBlurb.message: Some charged adjectives or dramatic framing.

mixedBlurb.message: Parts of the framing tilt each way. Worth reading with both lenses.

ctaBody.message: See how other outlets report this story

fineprint.message: An AI read of this article’s framing, not a rating of $1. Powered by TypeSafe.

notNewsBody.message: This page on $1 doesn’t read like news or opinion, so there’s no framing to rate.

pausedBody.message: Ground Truth only reads sites on your list. Add this one to see how its stories are framed.

emptyBody.message: Open a news story and Ground Truth reads its framing automatically.

emptyNote.message: Tab open since before installing? Reload the page.

notConnectedBody.message: Ground Truth reads articles through a service you point it at. Add its address and it starts working.

errorBody.message: Something went wrong analyzing $1. It’s usually temporary.

sitesBodyAll.message: Ground Truth reads every news story you open. Add sites to limit it to just those.

sitesBodySome.message: Ground Truth reads articles only on these sites and their subdomains.

serviceBody.message: Where articles go to be read. Run your own, or point at the one the project publishes.

privacyBody.message: The panel sends article text to the reading service above, which asks TypeSafe. Results stay only for this browser session.
